jobs.title: Chief of Staff, Engineering
jobs.description:
Cyberhaven is looking for a Chief of Staff for Engineering to collaborate and perform as an operating partner and force multiplier for engineering leadership, driving operating cadence, cross-organizational execution, and data-driven decision making across the entire engineering org. This role is accountable for turning strategic priorities into clear execution plans, and for giving leadership the visibility, metrics, and follow-through they need to run engineering like a well-oiled machine.

This is a hybrid role that blends program management, project management, and executive operations: the person in this role will sit close to engineering leadership, represent their priorities across the org, and be the connective tissue between strategy and day-to-day execution. Influence and impact come from judgment, trust, and cross-functional credibility rather than direct authority.

This role also serves as the primary architect of engineering leadership's monthly and quarterly business reviews, all-hands content, org planning, and leadership offsites  providing decision support, surfacing risk, and driving follow-through on the company's highest-priority engineering initiatives.

This role goes well beyond traditional chief of staff work. It requires strong executive presence to represent leadership credibly in front of the org and external stakeholders, deep comfort with data and metrics to turn fragmented signals into clear decision support, and an AI-forward mindset to automate the reporting and operating mechanisms that let Cyberhaven scale how it plans, tracks, communicates, and reviews its work.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP AND EXECUTIVE SUPPORT

 - Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to engineering leadership, helping translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans, success criteria, and operating mechanisms across the org

 - Own the engineering leadership operating cadence, including staff meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, org planning, and leadership offsites, setting agendas, preparing materials, and driving follow-through on decisions and action items

 - Represent engineering leadership's priorities across the organization, ensuring alignment between engineering, product, and go-to-market teams on key initiatives

 - Prepare executive-facing communications, board and all-hands content, and cross-functional updates on behalf of engineering leadership

 - Act as a sounding board and extension of leadership on sensitive or ambiguous organizational topics, including headcount planning, org design, and prioritization tradeoffs

 - Build trust and credibility across engineering, product, and business stakeholders to effectively drive alignment without formal authority


PROGRAM AND PROJECT MANAGEMENT

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and coordination across complex, multi-team programs and time-sensitive strategic projects for engineering leadership

 - Improve predictability in Cyberhaven's release and planning model by tracking scope changes, readiness risks, and cross-team dependencies

 - Build and maintain review cadences, status updates, and action follow-up systems that surface execution risk and areas needing intervention across teams and programs

 - Support high-priority or ambiguous engineering initiatives that need additional structure, executive visibility, and follow-through, often stepping in where no clear owner exists

 - Improve data hygiene and governance in systems like Jira and related planning artifacts so that ownership, status, and progress signals are reliable


DATA AND METRICS-DRIVEN OPERATIONS

 - Define and standardize success metrics across quality, release health, velocity, and team health to drive greater predictability and accountability

 - Turn operational signals from across the org into clear, data-backed reporting and decision support for engineering leadership

 - Own the metrics and narrative behind monthly and quarterly business reviews, ensuring leadership has accurate, timely, and actionable data

 - Bring a data-driven lens to org health, from delivery metrics to team sentiment, to help leadership spot risk early


AI-FORWARD AUTOMATION

 - Build AI-assisted dashboards and reporting workflows that improve visibility into program health, release scope, delivery risk, and team performance

 - Create automations that connect tools like Jira, Notion, GitHub, and Slack to surface planning, execution, release, and other delivery signals

 - Automate recurring chief of staff and program management processes such as status collection, follow-up tracking, review preparation, and stakeholder reporting

 - Use these workflows to improve business review inputs, leadership updates, and recurring status reporting while reducing manual status chasing


WHO YOU ARE

 - 7+ years of experience in a role combining program management, project management, and executive or leadership support

 - Prior experience as a Chief of Staff or Engineering Leadership roles a plus

 - Strong executive presence and the judgment to represent leadership credibly across the org and with external stakeholders

 - A data-driven, metrics-driven approach to decision making, with the ability to turn fragmented operational signals into clear reporting and insight

 - Proven ability to drive accountability, coordination, and follow-through across engineering and product teams without direct authority

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience owning monthly and quarterly business reviews, executive-facing updates, and cross-functional status reporting

 - Comfort using automation and AI to improve reporting quality, operating efficiency, and recurring workflow execution

 - Good judgment in prioritization, escalation, and leadership support in ambiguous or fast-moving situations

 - Experience owning QBRs, executive reporting, all-hands content, or org planning processes

 - Familiarity with DORA-style metrics, SLO/SLA thinking, release hygiene, and delivery scorecards

 - Experience building AI-assisted dashboards, automations, or reporting systems

 - Experience working in security, SaaS, endpoint, platform, or infrastructure-heavy environments

 - Experience supporting globally distributed engineering organizations

 - Prior experience transitioning from a technical or program management background into a Chief of Staff or executive operations role

 - Located in the Eastern Timezone to support our Global team.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

At Cyberhaven, we are building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise protecting organizations as work shifts from people alone to a mix of humans and AI agents. To help lead that shift, we seek AI-native thinkers who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work.

Cyberhaven is seeking a Marketing Operations leader to build and scale an AI-enabled revenue engine that powers our go-to-market motion, and to lead Marketing's AI maturity and innovation agenda more broadly. Reporting to our VP of Growth Marketing, this role owns the operational foundation and underlying models that make our full-funnel motion measurable and targeted, at a moment when our GTM motion is actively maturing across integrated campaigns, signal-based targeting, and a growing digital/growth capability.

You'll also lead analytics and reporting, building the infrastructure to track KPIs, inform decision-making, and align cross-functional stakeholders. This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in the details and knows how to connect data, process, and strategy to accelerate growth.




WHAT YOU'LL DO




STRATEGY & AI MATURITY

 - Partner with marketing leadership to define operational priorities that align with broader GTM and business goals.

 - Own Marketing's AI maturity roadmap — identifying where AI can improve targeting, personalization, and efficiency across the funnel, and establishing the governance and guardrails (data usage, quality control, human-in-the-loop checkpoints) that let it scale responsibly across teams.


SYSTEMS & INFRASTRUCTURE

 - Own and evolve the marketing technology stack — automation platform, CRM integrations, lead tracking, routing, attribution, and data hygiene, including AI-enabled workflows where they add real efficiency — building foundational systems where they don't yet exist.

 - Own the vision and evolution of Cyberhaven's marketing platform ecosystem, ensuring tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Demandbase, and Clay operate as one integrated system rather than disconnected point solutions.

 - Drive testing and optimization of scoring, segmentation, routing, and workflow logic, translating results into recommendations that improve performance.


REPORTING & MEASUREMENT

 - Build and maintain dashboards and reporting for campaign performance, funnel health, and pipeline impact across the full-funnel motion, helping identify business risks and investment opportunities.


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL & BUSINESS OPERATIONS

 - Align closely with Sales and Revenue Operations on lead flow, SLAs, reporting, and shared annual and quarterly targets.

 - Manage agencies and external partners as an extension of the team, with clear ownership, prioritization, and accountability to contracted agreements.

 - Manage the marketing operations budget and technology renewals, including reconciliation and forecasting with Finance, aligning resources with strategic goals.




WHO YOU ARE

 - 8+ years in Marketing Operations with progressive responsibility, including people management.

 - Experience building infrastructure in an early-stage or rapidly evolving environment.

 - Demonstrated experience leading AI adoption within a marketing or RevOps org, with a clear point of view on where AI meaningfully helps, and where it shouldn't be applied.

 - Demonstrated experience designing attribution models and account-based strategies, not just reporting on them; hands-on experience with Demandbase preferred

 - Proven ability to identify inefficiencies and design scalable systems from the ground up.

 - Highly organized with strong project management skills, able to drive complex projects from idea to execution.

 - High learning agility and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President of Sales
jobs.description:
Cyberhaven is building the AI-native data security platform for the agentic enterprise. Our data lineage technology traces the full lifecycle of enterprise data  across endpoints, browsers, SaaS, and cloud  and that foundation has made us a market leader in DLP and DSPM. It's also the launch pad for the next generation of products we are bringing to market.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Vice President of Sales, South East to join our team. This role offers a unique chance to build and grow our presence in the  region, driving sales strategies and expanding our market reach.



Who you are:

 - 10+ years of experience selling cybersecurity software (DLP, IRM, CASB, or adjacent data security categories)

 - Experience selling a multi-product security platform, not a single point solution — able to articulate platform value and lead with a land-and-expand strategy across a portfolio of offerings

 - Demonstrated track record of exceeding sales objectives leading enterprise security and networking sales teams, winning new business and driving substantial growth in Global 2000 accounts

 - Proven ability to build and drive sales teams executing land-and-expand strategies that predictably expand accounts, culminating in being chosen as an enterprise standard

 - Demonstrated competence engaging and developing value-based relationships with C-level executives

 - Minimum of 10 years of leadership experience, including second-line management, leading strategic software (preferably Key Account SaaS) teams

 - Excellent interpersonal skills; able to multitask, work cross-functionally, and thrive in a collaborative environment

 - Demonstrated sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Strategic Selling, etc.)

 - Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth software company where change is constant

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 - Excellent presentation skills

 - Ability to learn new technologies quickly

 - Located in Atlanta or Florida



What you’ll do:

 - Identify and pursue end-user opportunities, while driving interest and enablement with existing channel partners and identifying/onboarding new partners (with the Channels team)

 - Recruit, hire, and develop a high-performing enterprise security and networking software sales team, including Account Executives and Enterprise Systems Engineers

 - Drive strategy and lead the Key Accounts team to consistently exceed quarterly and annual sales objectives

 - Develop and lead the plan to significantly increase senior executive relationships with C-level executives in Key Accounts

 - Develop trust-based relationships with leaders across Product & Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Operations, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success

 - Develop pricing and product competence to play a leadership role in structuring, pursuing, and winning large, complex, multi-product deals across Cyberhaven's platform

 - Execute across all disciplines of sales management: account/territory/opportunity planning, sales methodology execution, forecasting, and professional development

 - Coach the team in a solution-based sales process spanning multiple groups within Global 2000 accounts

 - Proactively identify and address issues that inhibit growth in Key Accounts, and expand Cyberhaven's platform footprint (DLP, Insider Risk, Data Detection & Response, AI data security) in each account

 - Proactively develop key channel partner relationships at the executive level to ensure continued growth and over-achievement

 - Plan and coach prospecting campaigns with the team to ensure pipeline relative to quota for strong future revenue predictability

 - Maintain a 180-day rolling forecast, and build/manage/measure pipeline 6–12 months out

 - Lead and coach all aspects of the evaluation program/proof-of-concept with the team

 - Understand the competitive landscape and general business climate in the region

 - Continually self-teach, as formal training in emerging technologies may not exist

 - Understand and be expert in SaaS and cloud selling economics

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for an experienced, autonomous field marketing manager to lead and execute all field marketing initiatives across the West Region. This is not an entry-level field role: it requires someone who brings deep B2B cybersecurity experience, understands partner ecosystems, and operates independently, with minimal day-to-day direction.

The ideal candidate will own the full spectrum of regional marketing strategy and execution, from live and virtual events to partner programs, pipeline acceleration, and alignment with sales teams and executive stakeholders. You will have a proven track record of influencing the pipeline, championing creative programs, and using advanced tools to measure impact and iterate.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the West Region marketing strategy: Develop and execute a 12-month integrated plan aligned to sales priorities, go-to-market strategy, and regional opportunities. Translate business goals into actionable, persona-informed programs that address key buyer pain points across the customer lifecycle.

 - Design and deliver high-impact events and experiences: Plan and execute CISO dinners, roadshows, roundtables, golf outings, sporting events and show activations. Own all logistics, contracts, vendor management, and follow-up. Lead pre-event preparation and coordinate communications with sales, SDRs (sales development representatives), executives, and partners. Upload leads, work with marketing operations to confirm proper tracking, and report on pipeline influence and outcomes.

 - Align closely with sales and channel teams: Collaborate with account executives  and channel account managers to connect field marketing with sales motions. Participate in pipeline reviews, QBRs, and planning sessions. Proactively identify whitespace opportunities and activate programs that accelerate deals. Understand and support ABM strategies.

 - Develop and manage channel and partner marketing: Create co-branded programs with VARs and alliance partners that align with joint sales goals. Execute channel-specific campaigns and events while tracking shared KPIs. Use account mapping, segmentation, and competitive insights to prioritize efforts.

 - Use advanced digital tools and analytics: Apply business intelligence platforms, predictive analytics, and marketing automation to optimize campaign performance. Analyze funnel performance, forecast demand, and deliver actionable insights to leadership. Contribute to dashboards and executive-level reporting.

 - Own budget and performance metrics: Plan and manage regional budgets. Track spend against outcomes and adjust tactics based on real-time results. Understand demand waterfall performance and conversion velocity to improve program outcomes. Partner with sales leadership to review data and results regularly, drive continual improvement, and share key insights with the regional and national teams.

 - Contribute to campaign ideation and content strategy: Collaborate with global and product marketing on persona development, messaging, and localized content. Recommend program themes based on buyer insights, behavior, and market trends.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience: 6+ years of field marketing experience in B2B technology, cybersecurity experience strongly preferred.

 - Regional expertise: Experience working with West Region enterprise accounts and their buying committees.

 - Track record: A history of building and executing integrated field programs that influence pipeline and accelerate deals, owning a full calendar of regional events each quarter, including executive dinners, regional conferences, partner activations, and thought leadership programs.

 - Demand generation knowledge: Strong understanding of the buyer's journey, customer lifecycle, and demand generation best practices.

 - Budget management: Skilled in managing regional marketing budgets and reporting ROI  to stakeholders.

 - Cross-functional confidence: Comfortable working with sales, SDRs, partners, and marketing operations.

 - Tool familiarity: Familiar with key marketing tools, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, and Goldcast.

 - Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for sales, partners, and executives.

 - Ownership: High initiative and ownership, with the ability to operate independently and with minimal oversight.

 - Location and travel: Based in the West Region  with willingness to travel in and out of the region for events (up to 25%).
